### About Ace Aviation Services Corporation

Ace Aviation Services Corporation is an FAA-certificated charter / air taxi / commuter operator based in Fort Lauderdale, FL. The company has held its FAA operating certificate for over 23 years, having been first certificated in 2003. Key personnel include CEO Ellis, Barry, Director of Operations Ellis, Barry F., Chief Pilot Donovan, David.

### About Part 135 Operations

Part 135 governs on-demand charter flights and commuter air carriers. Part 135 operators provide air taxi, charter, and short-haul commuter services with aircraft seating 9 or fewer passengers. These operators must hold an Air Carrier Certificate and Operations Specifications issued by the FAA.
